title: DemVAMPS
synopsis:
Lavinia, a mysterious vampire girl,\n
and You, a boy destined to serve her.\n\n

Vampires who have lived within the human world are gathering in Tokyo, drawn by a struggle surrounding a throne that has lost its master.\n\n

Will Lavinia be the one to rule this world?\n\n

Or will it be someone else...?\n\n

(Source: Official Website, translated)
